programme.title: Yesterday Once More [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Gu Yuxuan and Han Shuyan almost had a fated encounter when they were children. After they grew up, the two met again as they are destined to fall in love. After experiencing the happiness and sweetness of love, they had to face the test of fate together. Can the miracle of love keep them together?

programme.title: The Great Battle [English Dub]
programme.desc: Witness the epic Siege of Ansi, where Goguryeo warriors defend against 500,000 Tang soldiers in THE GREAT BATTLE.

programme.title: Confession [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Min-ho's adulterous lover Se-hee is murdered in a hotel where only the two of them were present, and Min-ho is immediately singles out as the prime suspect. Insisting on his innocence, Min-ho hires the talented lawyer Shin-ae to defend him, and confesses to her that a car accident on the day before may be connected to Se-hee's murder...

programme.title: THE PRIESTS [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A priest and a skeptical young deacon try to save a girl who falls into a mysterious coma after a hit-and-run. Suspecting demonic possession, they perform an exorcism, but as they uncover the entity’s dark origins, they face a terrifying battle of faith and survival.

programme.title: To Be Killed by A High School Girl [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A man has an obsession that, if he is to die, it would be by being killed by a high school girl. With his strange obsession in mind, he decides to become a teacher.

programme.title: Manhole [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In one neighborhood in Seoul, about 10 people disappeared without a trace over 6 months. As even the smallest clues remain as to where the missing people have gone and who took them, residents' anxiety grows. Meanwhile, unidentifiable hair and blood stains were found on the manhole cover! What on earth is happening inside the manhole that threatens our peaceful daily life?

programme.title: River [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: On a calm winter’s day in Kibune, Kyoto, a mountain inn and its staff all find themselves trapped in a time loop.

programme.title: You Will Die in 6 Hours [English Sub]
programme.desc: Jung-yoon was approached by a random stranger named Jun-woo, who told her she'd be dead in six hours. As she follows him for answers, she begins to question whether he's her savior or the one trying to put her in danger.

programme.title: Ditto [English Dub]
programme.desc: A story about the love and friendship that takes place in an era where a man and a woman communicate through radio by chance.

programme.title: Tazza: The Hidden Card [English Dub]
programme.desc: Dae-gil, a young man with natural born talents in gambling, makes a dazzling debut as a gambler and gets reunited with his first love, Mi-na. However, Dae-gil soon becomes the scapegoat of betrayal and conspiracy and is forced to be on the run. Dae-gil plans to get revenge and prepares for one big, fated game for Mi-na who has been helping him every step of the way.

programme.title: Railway Heroes [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: This gripping historical drama tells the true story of the Shanghai Rail Corps, a team of railroad workers turned secret resistance fighters during the Second Sino-Japanese war.

programme.title: Hansan: Rising Dragon [English Dub]
programme.desc: In 1592, Admiral Yi Sun-sin uses the Turtle Ship to battle Japanese forces off Hansan Island. Epic naval clash ensues

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: A Gilded Game [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When a financial markets superstar, played by international legend Andy Lau, takes a new mentee under his wing, the mentee has to keep up and learn quick. Entering the fast-paced world of high finance and tackling an IPO on his first outing, he finds himself surrounded by competition eager to overtake him and break his newly formed association with the company’s kingmaker. Business fame is not easy, but is it too hard? Navigating that question is the hardest one of all.

programme.title: Oh Lucy! [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Bored Tokyo lady Setsuko (Independent Spirit Award-nominee Shinobu Terajima) breaks free of her monotonous life when her niece, Mika (Shioli Kutsuna) convinces her to enroll in an unorthodox English class. There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Immortal Demon Slayer [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The tale of Wukong, the legendary monkey warrior, and his journey to the Immortal Mountain to cultivate his kung-fu skills.

programme.title: Snatch Up [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Min-Jae is broke and needs to pay for his mother's operation. He decides to get his apartment deposit money back, but a bully takes his money. The bully gives his money to loan shark Baek who gives the money to politician Moon. Baek is not happy that he has to continually give money to the politician and decides to kill him. Baek hires a killer to take out Moon. Baek is in possession of a gun that Detective Choi gave up as a pledge at a gambling hall. Baek has the detective's gun delivered to the killer, but the delivery man mistakenly gives the gun to Min-Jae.

programme.title: Josée [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Young-seok and Josée first meet when he helps her after she falls from her wheelchair. Josée lives alone with her grandmother, and Young-seok begins to care about her and helps them both in any way he can. Gradually, Young-seok expresses his feelings to Josée, but she has never experienced such emotions before and keeps her distance from him.

programme.title: Inside Men [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A politician and a wealthy CEO scheme with a reputable journalist to create slush fund and to manipulate public opinion. They use Ahn Sang-gu, a gangster deeply involved in politics, to manage their slush fund, but Ahn Sang-gu gets caught and as a result is abandoned. Sang-gu is bent on having his revenge. On the other hand, Woo Jang-hoon, a prosecutor without any powerful friends, is desperate to solve the slush fund case so he can get a promotion.

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: The Night Owl [English Dub]
programme.desc: A period drama film, depicting Joseon Dynasty in Korea. Kyoung-su is a skilled acupuncturist but a blind who can only see a little at dark. Right after Kyoung-su joins King Injo’s medical team, the prince comes back after 7 years of living in Chung dynasty. Due to a long journey coming back, the prince becomes ill, and the king’s doctor brings Kyoung-su to heal him. But while Kyoung-su is doing his work, he finds out the king’s hidden secret which might change everything that the king owns. Could Kyoung-su be able to save everyone and himself?

programme.title: Warrior King [English Dub]
programme.desc: In this epic true story inspired by the legend of King Gesar, a young man grows up in exile in a world overrun by demons and monsters. When evil forces threaten his home, he returns to save his people and embrace his destiny as great hero and ruler.

programme.title: On Your Wedding Day [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A story of the 10-year emotional roller-coaster romance repeating a cycle of love and heartbreak begun as the high school crushes.

programme.title: Midnight [English Dub]
programme.desc: The witness who is unable to hear, becomes the serial killer's next target! 'Kyung-mi' who is deaf, was on the way home when she witnessed 'So-jung' bleeding out on the road. In her attempt to help, she becomes the new target of serial killer 'Do-shik.' 'Kyung-mi' runs in desperation and willingness to survive but cannot hear even the murderer's footsteps! During the night, in the middle of Seoul, begins the unstoppable chase between a serial killer and his newest target, 'Kyung-mi'! An extreme silent chase thriller!
